name: Horizon Config
description: Settings screens as Mod Menu finds them: the mod's own (getModConfigScreenFactory), one it gives another mod (getProvidedConfigScreenFactories, as Forge Config API Port does), and a broken "modmenu" entrypoint (a class that isn't a ModMenuApi, as Compressed Blocks has). Each screen logs its parent and goes back to it on Done. A check of the Java mod bridge's Mods page.
